This flip rate exceeds the size-matched control by \PcSymFireSize{} \ci{\PcSymFireSizeCI} and the change-matched control by \PcSymFireChg{} \ci{\PcSymFireChgCI}, while overturning only \PcTaFireK{} of \PcTaN{} true acceptances (\PcTaFire{} across \PcTaPlans{} plans in \PcTaCities{} cities; difference \PcTaDiff{} \ci{\PcTaDiffCI}). Post-earthquake fire propagation is thus a genuine causal locus of exploitation.\else On \emph{recover}, once evaluated against plans that both model and oracle accept, fire-state patching does not isolate a specific subsystem mechanism.\fi\else\slot{F1}{symmetric fire-patching specificity check}\fi}

\newcommand{\HorLadderSentence}{Across all \LadFinals{} final checkpoints on the ladder, \HorLadGeMin{} to \HorLadGeMax{} of the \HorOverlays{} spatial overlays exhibit \Horizon-month errors no smaller than copying the initial state (at least \HorPfGeMin{} for each pushforward-tuned model), pollution error is \HorPollMin{} to \HorPollMax{} times the copy baseline, and open-loop powered-zone count error spans \HorPowMin{} to \HorPowMax{} zones (Appendix Table~\ref{tab:horizon}).
